shortDescription: Commander, local forces cannot spare a lance for a sweep, and the sector has to be investigated before the window to take advantage of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} deployments closes. Cover each waypoint in the order we give you, keep your forces moving between those points, and tell us what is out there at each waypoint. Don't get bogged down in fighting; that's not why you are out there. You should expect a serious fight to be offered along the route. You need to resist the temptation to accept the battle.
longDescription: Call the contacts as you pass them, Commander, and keep the lance pointed at the next waypoint rather than at the last force that shot at you.

objectiveList.title: Destroy All Buildings Within the Objective Zone
objectiveList.description: The objective counts the structures inside the mark. Destroy them all.

objectiveList.title: Reach Waypoint 1 in 9 rounds with your entire lance
Reach Waypoint 2 in 12 rounds with your entire lance
Reach Waypoint 3 in 7 rounds with your entire lance
Get to the dust-off in 7 rounds
Reach Waypoint 4 in 16 rounds with your entire lance

dialogueContent.words: Patrol route is marked for us, Commander. Hit every waypoint before you run out of time. Do not linger and get to the first waypoint as quickly as you can.
Clock's half gone, Commander. Get to the next waypoint.
One round left to reach the next waypoint, Commander.
Dropship is inbound. Get to the dust-off location and see if you can shake any enemy units that are still on your tail.
The window to reach the next waypoint is gone, Commander; we are being pulled out.
That's the patrol complete, Commander, it's time to come home. Nice footwork out there.
We're out of time, Commander, this mission is a bust.
